item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President describes an internal executive-management direction requiring Federal agencies to adopt workplace policies; the consequence occurs through agency implementation rather than through a present change in legal rights.","evidence":"I directed all Federal agencies to adopt domestic violence workplace policies"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President makes a commemorative proclamation and a hortatory appeal to the public, neither of which governs agencies or changes legal rights.","evidence":"do hereby proclaim October 2016 as National Domestic Violence Awareness Month"}]}
